messages:
alen: Heads-up: we're deprecating the old streaming param `resume_token` in favor of `stream_resume` (boolean). Need a concise release-note bullet, an SDK migration snippet, and a known-issue callout about proxy header stripping. Target: publish in the morning deploy.
tori: I put a draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1678 - added the blurb under /releases/streaming-deprecations and a short migration section. PTAL.
pat: Saw it on staging. Two quick things: 1) recommend SDK bump to >=0.11.2 which maps `resume_token` to `stream_resume` and provides a compatibility shim; 2) add a troubleshooting note that some corporate proxies strip reconnect headers which leads to full restarts rather than resumptions.
pat: Example of the shim in Python (one-liner):
```python
# SDK >=0.11.2: backwards-compatible mapping
client = RedwoodClient(stream_resume=True)  # maps legacy resume_token automatically
```
tori: Added that snippet and a one-line curl example for ops to test reconnect behavior: 
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?prompt=test -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```
alen: For the known-issue pill please add: "Some HTTP proxies may remove reconnect headers (e.g., `Reconnect-Token`), causing streams to restart and duplicate partial output. Recommend upgrading SDK or routing through supported proxies." Keep it short.
pat: Also adding a tiny instrumentation example showing how to detect restart in response metadata so customers can alert:
```json
{"event":"stream_reconnect","reason":"header_missing","restarted_at":"2026-03-20T10:00:00Z"}
```
docs-ci: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1678--docs.redwood.ai (rendered: /releases/streaming-deprecations). Lint + link-check passed.
tori: Can reviewers react with :shipit: by EOD? I want to merge and schedule the site cut for 07:45 tomorrow.
pat: :shipit: added small comment about wording in the migration section.
alen: :shipit: checked preview and examples.
docs-ci: Final build green. Merged and scheduled deploy at 07:45.
support-bot: Notifying support channel about SDK deprecation window and troubleshooting steps (auto-message).
alen: Thanks team, I'll add the release-note bullet to the internal tracker and ping product. Closing thread. :wave:
